archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-08.6 Promote Knowledge Sharing and Capability Building
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Finally, innovation must be socialized. New methods are shared with statisticians, methodologists, and product teams. Short trainings, internal webinars, or method notes are published. Feedback is collected from first users. This closes the loop: improvements can be made, and the method matures over time. Innovation becomes part of the organization, not just part of one project.
Value created: Organization-wide uptake of proven innovations and a culture of continuous improvement.
